svg.title: BrewLite target deployment: Vercel and Render
svg.desc: Target design, not verified live. Next.js on Vercel proxies HTTPS to NestJS on Render. PostgreSQL uses private TCP. VNPay Return uses the browser; IPN calls the backend directly. Local and CI are isolated from the production target. Planned builds use Vercel prebuilt upload and Render Docker build with its managed private image registry, without a separate BrewLite registry.

g.text: ASSIGNMENT 2 - TARGET DESIGN | Vercel Hobby + Render + VNPay Sandbox | Live verification pending
PRODUCTION TARGET / PUBLIC HTTPS | Browser and VNPay are external
CI build -> Vercel assets / server runtime
NestJS + Prisma Client; IPN + shared finalization
PostgreSQL is not a public API
READ THIS AS A TARGET DESIGN
Environments: Local, isolated CI, Production target (not verified).
Solid arrows: target runtime communication (verify after deploy).
Purple dashed arrows: planned CI/CD deployment dependencies.
Green boundary: private DB path; no browser / Vercel DB link.
Secrets: Render server env; CI deployment keys in GitHub Secrets.
Return is navigation only. IPN / QueryDR verify before finalization.
Crossing lines without a junction do not indicate a connection.
Frontend: CI Vercel build -> prebuilt upload to Vercel.
Backend: Git SHA + apps/api/Dockerfile -> Render Docker build
No separate BrewLite image registry (GHCR / Docker Hub).
Task 5: tagged-image / release / rollback evidence required.
Live URLs / CI/CD / migration / payment E2E: still pending.
